title: Compact guides for interactive states and data visualization API notes
creator: Amira Patel
description: Create a compact, developer-facing section for the docs site that consolidates: token usage for interactive states (hover, focus, pressed), button API examples for primary/secondary/destructive variants, table row selection patterns, and chart annotation/tooltip guidance. The goal is a lightweight one-page reference (with links to deep dives) that helps engineers migrate legacy token names, avoid common anti-patterns (e.g., using text tokens for elevation), and implement accessible interactive components consistently. Deliverables: page copy, annotated code samples (JSX + CSS tokens), example fixtures for tables and charts, migration note with automatic codemod recommendations, and a short style checklist for accessibility QA.
acceptance_criteria: One compact doc page published under /components/quick-guides with responsive layout
Clear token mapping table from legacy tokens -> new token names, plus recommended replacements for edge cases
At least 6 copy-pasteable code examples: buttons (3 variants), table selection, sortable headers, chart tooltip + annotation sample
Migration note with suggested codemod commands and a sample before/after diff
Design and Eng sign-off recorded in comments and PR merged (GitHub PR linked)
Accessibility checklist included and validated by Accessibility team
work_log: 2026-02-20: Kickoff with PM and Engineering to prioritize tokens vs component surface area. Decided to scope to interactive states and data-visualization because they cause most bugs in customer repos.
2026-02-24: Drafted initial page outline and a simplified mapping table for legacy tokens; flagged 3 ambiguous legacy tokens that need API review.
2026-03-01: Prototype code snippets added for Button variants and table selection. Discovered inconsistent focus ring token usage across components; opened ENG-4021.
2026-03-04: Accessibility review with Saroja: suggested stronger contrast for chart annotations and keyboard focus tests for table row selection. Updated doc checklist.
2026-03-08: Incorporated feedback from frontend review (PR feedback). Reduced sample complexity, added small perf note about avoiding per-cell expensive renders in large tables.
2026-03-10: Prepared PR for docsite; requested reviews from Design Lead and Eng Lead. Marked ticket as 'In Progress' while awaiting code review merge.
design_feedback: Design lead (Lina Ortega): prefer 'do/don't' micro-illustrations for the button states section to make guidance scannable
Frontend (Mateo Ruiz): provide both token name and runtime CSS variable example to reduce onboarding friction
Accessibility (Saroja Kulkarni): add explicit keyboard-only examples for sortable headers and row expansion
decisions: Keep compact guide limited to single page with anchors to deep-dives to reduce navigation friction
Expose both token name and runtime CSS var in code examples (e.g. var(--rwd-color-interactive-hover))
Recommend codemod instead of automated migration for 3 ambiguous legacy tokens to avoid breaking edge-case visual regressions
Exclude layout/elevation tokens from this guide; redirect to the tokens canonical page
